asset_authoring.ai.title: Asset authoring: ai
asset_authoring.ai.description: Create/edit/save/read-back tasks for one Unreal asset-authoring domain.

task_refs.description: Create a Blackboard and BehaviorTree, edit Blackboard keys, link the tree to the Blackboard, save, and inspect both

Create parent/child Blackboards, inherit parent keys, duplicate the child Blackboard, save, and read inherited/local keys back
Create a child Blackboard without a parent, assign its parent via set_bb_parent, save, and verify inherited/local keys
Create a StateTree asset, add and rename a root state, compile, save, and inspect the tree structure
Create a SmartObjectDefinition, add and configure a slot, save, and read slot metadata back
Create a SmartObjectDefinition, add a slot behavior definition, duplicate the definition, save both assets, and inspect behavior metadata
Create a BehaviorTree with direct node, decorator, service, property, and delete edits, then read the exact authored graph back
Build an EQS query from a declarative generator/test/scoring/filter spec, save it, and verify the materialized query graph
Create a MassEntityConfigAsset, capture an available Mass trait class, add it, save and read it back, then remove the trait and validate the empty config warning
